projecthero.guide.omnitrix.alien.arctigu: A Polar Manzardill: a quick blue reptile who breathes ice. His freezing breath encases enemies in blocks of ice, he raises walls of it, and the cold never touches him. Hidden: a mistransform finds him.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.arctiguana.rol: Ice breather: slows and freezes crowds solid, walls them off and slides away.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.arctiguana.pas: Cold Blooded: freezing and powder snow never hurt or slow him.
Freezes things solid in a block of ice (no blocks harmed): his breath, his spit on a frosted foe, and Deep Freeze.
Agile: quick on his feet, springy, and a frictionless Ice Slide (X).
projecthero.omnitrix.info.arctiguana.wea: Heat: fire and lava hurt him half again.
A light body: no armour to speak of without Frost Armour (V).
Not on the dial until a mistransform (the 11th, 22nd, 33rd...) finds him.
projecthero.omnitrix.arctiguana.ice_brea: Breathe freezing air for 1.5 s in a 7-block cone: 3 every quarter second, slowed and frosted. A creature caught by three gusts (or two, if already frosted) is frozen solid in a block of ice for 3 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.arctiguana.ice_shar: Spit a shard of ice at the crosshair: 7, and it frosts what it hits. A frosted creature it hits freezes solid for 2 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.arctiguana.frost_wa: Raise a 5-wide, 3-high wall of ice 2.5 blocks ahead (only into empty air). It melts away after 8 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.arctiguana.deep_fre: A burst of cold round you (6 blocks): 17 to everything in it, and all of it frozen solid for 3 s (bosses briefly).
projecthero.omnitrix.arctiguana.ice_slid: A frictionless slide where you look for 0.8 s, leaving frost behind. Whatever you slide through takes 4 and is frosted. No fall damage while sliding.
projecthero.omnitrix.arctiguana.tail_whi: Spin and swing your tail right round you (3.5 blocks): 8, knocked back.
projecthero.omnitrix.arctiguana.frost_ar: 10 s of ice plates: you take 40% less damage, and whatever hits you up close is frosted and takes 2.
projecthero.omnitrix.arctiguana.frost_cl: Your punches hit for +5 and frost what they hit (slowed; frost it twice and his breath or spit freezes it sooner).
projecthero.omnitrix.arctiguana.cold_blo: Freezing and powder snow never hurt or slow you.
projecthero.omnitrix.arctiguana.reptile_: Quick, springy and light on your feet; short falls don't hurt.
projecthero.omnitrix.arctiguana.heat_wea: Fire and lava hurt you half again.
